name: Execution Verification
runtime_tests: Request one simple edit and verify execution_verification.status=complete.
Request a multi-operation change where one operation cannot apply; verify status=partial and Luna does not say Done.
Request an invalid/unavailable structural operation; verify status=failed and zero success claim.
Move a section and verify target/to_index match.
Replace a section and verify the requested Spark key is the applied Spark key.
Confirm Builder and Trial both return execution_verification.
